craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of demolition and retorsion — utsāha as each counterfeit falls and the proof-text turns witness. Thesis in dawning-body; participial setup line 1, spine line 2 (L3 note); kha variant logged not sung. Rejected: (a) singing kha bhedātma → killed: main text followed. (b) conquering→victorious → killed: L3 frozen. Read aloud: DAWN-ing IN a-BO-dy BUILT of re-LA-tion … ONE, yet CONQ-uer-ing: WORLD-self, LIGHT, su-PREME-lord.

lines: Dawning in a body built of relation — being, difference, and the rest —
one, yet conquering: world-self, light, supreme Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhāvabhedādisaṃbandhamayena vapuṣonmiṣan jayatyeko'pi viśvātmā prakāśaḥ parameśvaraḥ
notes: line 1 participial setup (vapuṣonmiṣan), spine carried by line 2

reads_against.argmap: What is relation, at the opening thesis? → Thesis stated: relation is the Lord's dawning body-form, not an accident of things.
c1_essence: Relation's counterfeits are refused one by one — awaiting, two-seatedness, uninterruptedness need a consciousness they deny — until form-fusion stands: the many's one-selfhood (vv1-5).
The Buddhist proof-text is turned against its makers: unmixed things thought-joined is no mere thought but unwardable shining-clinging, warrantable in recognition's path (vv6-9).
